info.title: Gondwana CLI
info.description: Developer CLI for the Gondwana Game Engine. Create projects, validate your setup, pack assets, inspect projects, and manage templates — all from the command line. Install globally with: dotnet tool install --global Gondwana.Cli

options.description:
Path to a JSON file that maps asset types to
